decisions: 95: source says no great snipe yet mentions three birds in the bag; retain, do not invent species for the bag. Decrease number of parishes and preserve own church, not general repairs.

96: preserve landowner prejudice and advocacy of coercion as character speech. First third of tax, taxable household, volost court, tenant farmer, quarter kopeck, chetvert volume restored. Economic rent is jordrente, not ordinary rental payment.
96: Russian horse treadmill is a threshing-machine drive, not a press; Percheron and Bityug names and pun restored. Translation of pun is functional and needs native review.
96: шапками закидаем boast restored as cap-pelting image, with context; not throwing hats over a windmill (different idiom in 86).
97: sinkhole, beside-desk stand, material development, past healer visit, bouncing mattress, counting and winter crops restored. Spencer love is source irony; not flattened to dislike.
